A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''jewel thief''' was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the thief stole a [[Unidentified priceless bangle|priceless bangle]] that was commissioned for the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] of a [[Unidentified crime lord (bangle)|crime lord's]] [[Unidentified crime lord's daughter|daughter]], the thief sought help from an underworld individual to smooth over the situation. The negotiator convinced the crimelord to buy the bangle from the thief for a fraction of the [[Unidentified jeweler|jeweler's]] price, ending the tense situation.<ref name="Too Hot to Handle" />
